enemies.name: Nethersea Founder
enemies.flavour_text: A Sea Terror that has inexplicably grown a chitinous skull. There is no corresponding organ to be found beneath it.

abilities.text: Spawns Nethersea Brand at its location when defeated
Gains increased RES

enemies.name: Nourished Founder
enemies.flavour_text: A Sea Terror that generally only metamorphoses within an abundance of the nethersea brand. They can on exceptionally rare occasions be born from the remains of their multiple kin.

abilities.text: Spawns Nethersea Brand at its location when defeated
Gains increased RES

enemies.name: Regressed Founder
enemies.flavour_text: A special individual among the Founders. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.

abilities.text: Spawns Nethersea Brand at its location when defeated
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Gains increased RES

enemies.name: Nethersea Predator
enemies.flavour_text: A Sea Terror that has learned to use its chitinous skull to deal physical attacks, storing scraps of food in its body comprised of countless tiny creatures.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

enemies.name: Nourished Predator
enemies.flavour_text: A Sea Terror that has learned to hunt efficiently. They themselves do not appear to require nutrients, instead reserving them for their lower-level kin. Before they die, they turn themselves into one last food source.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

enemies.name: Regressed Predator
enemies.flavour_text: A special individual among the Predators. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.

abilities.text: Cannot be blocked while on Nethersea Brand
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Gains Physical and Arts dodge (disabled by certain negative statuses)

enemies.name: Nethersea Brandguider
enemies.flavour_text: A new type of Sea Terror formed from a colony that was about to decay and die. In order to effectively utilize the last bit of nutrients in their bodies, all they need to do is smear themselves across the ground.

abilities.text: After falling below half HP, spreads Nethersea Brand to tiles it travels over
After falling below half HP, gains increased DEF and Block requirement

enemies.name: Nourished Brandguider
enemies.flavour_text: Even if not on the verge of death, they will still choose to expand the survival range of their kin using their own flesh and blood. Reminiscent of the Bishop's final journey back to Iberia.

abilities.text: After falling below half HP, spreads Nethersea Brand to tiles it travels over
After falling below half HP, gains increased DEF and Block requirement

enemies.name: Regressed Brandguider
enemies.flavour_text: A special individual among the Brandguiders. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.

abilities.text: After falling below half HP, spreads Nethersea Brand to tiles it travels over
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] After falling below half HP, gains increased DEF and Block requirement

enemies.name: Nethersea Spewer
enemies.flavour_text: Possesses a hard, chitinous shell that it uses to protect itself, possibly capable of sporulation or a similar function. A commonly seen Sea Terror where the nethersea brand proliferates.

abilities.text: Can attack all targets located on Nethersea Brand
Attacks 3 enemies simultaneously

enemies.name: Nourished Spewer
enemies.flavour_text: A Sea Terror that has largely lost control of its functions, spewing out its spore-like progeny at a rate that surpasses its physical capacity, causing it to wear itself out prematurely.

abilities.text: Can attack all targets located on Nethersea Brand
Attacks 3 enemies simultaneously

enemies.name: Regressed Spewer
enemies.flavour_text: A special individual among the Spewers. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.

abilities.text: Can attack all targets located on Nethersea Brand
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Attacks 3 targets simultaneously

enemies.name: Nethersea Swarmcaller
enemies.flavour_text: A rare Sea Terror, able to manipulate the tiny creatures in the air and on the ground to eat away at their surroundings even in the absence of the nethersea brand. They seem to call the brand itself to life, hence their name.

abilities.text: Continually inflicts Arts damage and Nervous Impairment in an area around it
Has Status resistance and is immune to Slow

enemies.name: Nourished Swarmcaller
enemies.flavour_text: A special and extremely-rare individual, boasting incredible destructive power and far-reaching transmission range. They are unable to be dealt with through conventional means, Inquisitors must be extra vigilant around them.

abilities.text: Continually inflicts Arts damage and Nervous Impairment in an area around it
Has Status resistance and is immune to Slow

enemies.name: Regressed Swarmcaller
enemies.flavour_text: A special individual among the Swarmcallers. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.

abilities.text: Continually inflicts Arts damage and Nervous Impairment in an area around it
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Has Status resistance and is immune to Slow

enemies.name: Nethersea Reefbreaker
enemies.flavour_text: An extremely aggressive individual born from the nethersea brand, capable of inflicting tremendous damage to its surrounding environment for its kin to transform. Lifeforms not considered kin fall under this category.

abilities.text: Gains Invisibility when on Nethersea Brand
Gains increased ATK for each time it deals damage, decaying quickly after it stops attacking
Deals increased damage to enemies blocking this unit

enemies.name: Nourished Reefbreaker
enemies.flavour_text: A Sea Terror born from the nethersea brand, used to expel entities that pose a significant threat to its kin, or to completely destroy environments unsuitable for sustaining life. All civilizations on land fall under this category.

abilities.text: Gains Invisibility when on Nethersea Brand
Gains increased ATK for each time it deals damage, decaying quickly after it stops attacking
Deals increased damage to enemies blocking this unit

enemies.name: Regressed Reefbreaker
enemies.flavour_text: A special individual among the Reefbreakers. Heeding the call of We Many, its body is ready to be preyed upon.

abilities.text: Gains Invisibility when on Nethersea Brand
Leaves its remains on location when defeated
[Directed Evolution] Gains increased ATK after successfully dealing damage, decaying quickly after it stops attacking

enemies.name: The Endspeaker, Will of We Many
enemies.flavour_text: The tiny Seaborn that haunted the mighty Stultifera, the blood of its parents once strewn across the ocean's waters. The revelation reaches not the ears of the children, their kind's destiny quietly continuing to flow.

abilities.text: When defeated, disappears for a short time before evolving into its next form
When evolving into its next form, gains the following effects in this order: Gains increased DEF/Gains increased Movement Speed/Gains increased ATK and Lifesteal

[Consume] Consumes the [Remains] of its Seaborn kin, gaining their corresponding [Directed Evolution] ability in the next evolutionary phase, while also instantly defeating any Operators near the Remains and preventing them from being redeployed for a period of time.
